source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Treat the outer 1-inch border of the sterile field as contaminated and keep all sterile supplies away from that boundary throughout the procedure.","B":"Keep the sterile field continuously in view and replace any item whose sterility becomes uncertain before continuing the bedside procedure.","C":"Reach an unsterile arm directly across the open sterile field while passing an item to another clinician working on the opposite side of the bed.","D":"Add sterile supplies without reaching over the field, using a method that keeps the package and the nurse's hands safely outside the sterile area."}}
source_row.rationale: Only sterile items and aseptic movements should enter or pass over a sterile field. Option C contaminates the field by placing an unsterile arm directly over it. Option A correctly treats the outer 1-inch border as contaminated. Option B correctly keeps the field under observation and replaces items of uncertain sterility. Option D describes a safe way to add supplies without reaching over the field.
